readings: Matching each attendance record to its member by member id (dropping attendance with no matching member), count the attendance records for each member id and `position` combination, and work out each count as a share of the total of all these counts. List the member id, position, attendance count and share, sorted by share from highest to lowest, and return exactly 10 rows. If there is a tie at 10th place, keep only as many of the tied rows as fit, chosen arbitrarily.
queries:
SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
FROM attendance a
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;
